# Ángel Calderón

> Software Architect & AI Engineer based in Caracas, Venezuela. I design and build web & mobile products with a focus on performance, UX, security, and deployment. My stack spans Python, Next.js, React Native, Flutter, RAG systems, and IoT. Open to remote work worldwide.

## Featured Projects
- [OSINT-D2](https://angelcalderon.dev/projects/osint-d2): Autonomous AI agent for identity investigation. Give it a username or email and it scans 20+ platforms, finds new leads, pivots on them autonomously, and delivers an evidence-based 6-dimension profile as a PDF dossier. Open source, Docker-ready, with AI able to run locally via Ollama. Stack: Python, FastAPI, Playwright, Docker.
- [Eficense Residence](https://angelcalderon.dev/projects/eficense): IoT & AI security ecosystem for residential management. Bridges physical security hardware with modern cloud architecture, automating visitor access and financial reporting for 150+ unit condominiums. Stack: Next.js, Python, FastAPI, PostgreSQL, Redis, DeepSeek API.
- [Studia](https://angelcalderon.dev/projects/studia): AI-powered EdTech SaaS. Omnichannel AI tutoring ecosystem for schools that ingests institutional data to create personalized RAG agents for students, accessible directly via WhatsApp. Stack: React Native, Python, FastAPI, WhatsApp Cloud API, Vector DB.
- [Scenery](https://angelcalderon.dev/projects/scenery): Modern CLI wallpaper manager for Linux power users. High-performance tool to manage, tag, and organize large wallpaper collections, integrating seamlessly with tiling window managers like Hyprland. Stack: Python, Typer, Rich.
- [Born AI](https://angelcalderon.dev/projects/born-ai): Predictive genetics with LLMs. Web app using OpenAI to generate explanatory prediction summaries from structured inputs. 2nd Place Winner in a coding competition. Stack: Next.js, OpenAI, TailwindCSS.
- [Appod](https://angelcalderon.dev/projects/appod): NASA APOD explorer mobile app. Flutter app integrating NASA's Astronomy Picture of the Day API with a Python backend. 500+ requests. Stack: Flutter, Python, Firebase.
